policy: Complete five independent cases at each level, retaining all outcomes. If at most half solve, freeze ten additional distinct cases at the same level as confirmation; otherwise escalate. Stop a task as difficulty_confirmed only if at most half of the independent confirmation cases solve; otherwise escalate again. Prior isolated errors never stop the ladder. Report illegal actions, unsolved plans, parse failures, truncation and formatting separately; successful plans with formatting violations count as solved. Task-round-robin scheduling, up to four concurrent calls, at most one active call per task. Retry only infrastructure failures; preserve every valid answer and the original 40-case suites. Finite configured ranges are guards, not proof that a difficult regime must exist. Report range_exhausted when all configured levels remain too easy. This adaptive screen and small confirmation set do not establish population success rates.
